# CLI リファレンス

`wpg` バイナリはサーバ (`wpg serve`) とヘッドレスのツールを兼ねるため、CI や ssh 先での実行にも向いています。例えば `wpg send tpl.wpg.yaml -i eth0 --rate 1Mpps` でテンプレートを送出します。このページはコマンド定義から自動生成しており、各コードブロックは現行ビルドの `--help` 出力そのものです。実行時のメッセージは `LANG` / `LC_ALL` に従いますが、`--help` の文面は英語です。

## コマンド

### `wpg`

```text
Web Packet Generator

Usage: wpg [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve     Start the web UI / API server
  send      Send a template headlessly
  render    Render a template to a pcapng file without transmitting
  import    Convert a pcap/pcapng capture into a template
  template  Template tools (lint, list, migrate, export, import)
  ifaces    List network interfaces usable for transmission
  doctor    Diagnose privileges, drivers, hugepages and Npcap
  bench     Measure transmit performance
  capture   Receive: counters, the first frames, pcapng output, signature verification
  config    Configuration file tools (init, show, validate)
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg serve`

```text
Start the web UI / API server

Usage: wpg serve [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --bind <BIND>
          Address to listen on (default from the config: 127.0.0.1:8080). Without a password only loopback addresses are accepted (see --allow-insecure)

          [env: WPG_BIND]

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --password <PASSWORD>
          Admin password (plain text or argon2 hash). Visible in the process list: prefer --password-file, `WPG_PASSWORD` or `wpg config set-password`

      --password-file <FILE>
          File holding the admin password (plain text or argon2 hash)

      --tls
          Serve HTTPS; without `[server.tls]` a self-signed certificate is generated into `<data_dir>/tls/`

      --allow-insecure
          Listen on a non-loopback address even though no password is configured (anyone reaching the server can then set it on the setup screen)

      --config <FILE>
          Configuration file (default: `wpg.toml` in the working directory, if any)

          [env: WPG_CONFIG]

      --dev
          Development mode: allow CORS from the Trunk dev server (:8081)

      --library-path <DIR>
          Template library directory (repeatable; replaces `templates.library_paths`)

      --data-dir <DIR>
          Data directory (user templates, history)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg send`

テンプレートを送出します。`--plan` は、全フレームを先に展開する (`prerender`) か、送出しながら組み立てる (`onthefly`) かを選びます。`--json` は最終レポートを標準出力に JSON で出します。

```text
Send a template headlessly

Usage: wpg send [OPTIONS] <TEMPLATE>

Arguments:
  <TEMPLATE>
          Template file (`.wpg.yaml`)

Options:
  -i, --iface <IFACE>
          Interface to transmit on

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --backend <BACKEND>
          Transmit backend (null, pcapfile, pcap, afpacket, afxdp, dpdk)

      --count <COUNT>
          Number of packets

      --duration <DURATION>
          Duration limit, e.g. `10s`, `2m`

      --rate <RATE>
          Rate, e.g. `1Mpps`, `10Gbps`, `50%`, `ifg=10us`, `unlimited`

      --burst <BURST>
          Frames sent back to back per rate-control grant

      --wait <MODE>
          How the rate control waits: hybrid (sleep, then spin), sleep, spin or busy-poll (spin and service the backend)

      --clock <CLOCK>
          Rate-control clock: auto (TSC when invariant), tsc or monotonic

          [default: auto]

      --ramp-up <DURATION>
          Ramp the rate up linearly from 0 over this time, e.g. `5s`

      --start-at <TIME>
          Start at this time: RFC 3339 (`2026-09-29T12:00:00Z`) or a delay (`+10s`)

      --plan <PLAN>
          Expansion strategy: auto, prerender or onthefly

          [default: auto]

      --json
          Print the final report as JSON on stdout

      --var <NAME=VALUE>
          Template variable override (`name=value`), repeatable

      --signature
          Stamp every frame with a receive-verification signature (magic, stream id, sequence number, TX time over the last 24 payload octets; see `wpg capture --verify`)

      --stream-id <ID>
          Signature stream id (with `--signature`)

          [default: 0]

      --batch <N>
          Frames per `send_batch` call

      --ring-depth <N>
          TX ring depth in frames (`afpacket`)

      --pin-core <CORE>
          Pin the TX thread to this CPU core (Linux; the first worker)

      --pin-cores <CORES>
          Pin worker i to the i-th core of this list, e.g. `1,2` (Linux)

      --workers <N>
          TX worker threads, each with its own backend instance (afpacket: socket and ring) and share of the stream and rate

          [default: 1]

      --qdisc-bypass
          Bypass the qdisc layer (`afpacket`, `PACKET_QDISC_BYPASS`)

      --no-tx-ring
          Use `sendmmsg` instead of the TPACKET_V3 TX ring (`afpacket`)

      --auto-pin
          Pin the workers to cores on the NIC's NUMA node, core 0 last (Linux; ignored when --pin-cores is given)

      --queue <N>
          First hardware queue (`afxdp`, `dpdk`; worker i uses queue N+i)

      --xdp-mode <MODE>
          AF_XDP bind mode: auto (zero-copy, else copy), copy or zerocopy

          [default: auto]

      --busy-poll
          Busy polling: `afxdp` sockets busy-poll the driver (kernel 5.11+) and `wpg send` paces with `--wait busy-poll` unless --wait says otherwise

      --eal-args <ARGS>
          DPDK EAL arguments (`dpdk`), e.g. "-a 0000:00:04.0 --file-prefix wpg" (split on whitespace; wpg adds `-l <first CPU>` and `--in-memory` unless given)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg render`

送出せずに、テンプレートのフレームを pcapng ファイルへ書き出します。

```text
Render a template to a pcapng file without transmitting

Usage: wpg render [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT> <TEMPLATE>

Arguments:
  <TEMPLATE>
          Template file

Options:
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Output pcapng file

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --count <COUNT>
          Number of packets

      --var <NAME=VALUE>
          Template variable override (`name=value`), repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg import`

キャプチャ (または貼り付けた 16 進) をテンプレートに変換します。[pcap からテンプレートへのチュートリアル](../tutorials/pcap-replay.md)も参照してください。

```text
Convert a pcap/pcapng capture into a template

Usage: wpg import [OPTIONS] <INPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>
          Input: a `.pcap` / `.pcapng` capture, a hex dump (`.hex`, see `--hex`) or `-` for standard input

Options:
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>
          Output template (`-` prints YAML on standard output)

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --per-packet <DIR>
          Write one template per packet into this directory instead of one merged template

      --first-protocol <PROTOCOL>
          Protocol the frames start with

          [default: ethernet2]

      --max-packets <N>
          Read at most this many packets

      --no-detect-generators
          Do not infer generators (range / list / random) from the packets

      --hex
          Treat the input as pasted hex (Wireshark hex stream, spaced bytes, hexdump)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg template`

テンプレートのツール。`lint` はエラー時に終了ステータス 1 を返します。`export` と `import` はテンプレートを `.wpgbundle` アーカイブにまとめ、展開します。

```text
Template tools (lint, list, migrate, export, import)

Usage: wpg template [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  lint     Check templates for errors and warnings (exit status 1 on errors)
  list     List the templates of a directory (default: `templates/`)
  show     Print the built packet (hex dump and layout tree) of a template
  schema   Print the JSON Schema of the template format
  export   Pack templates (files or ids) into a `.wpgbundle` archive
  migrate  Upgrade templates to the current schema version
  import   Extract the templates of a `.wpgbundle` archive into a directory
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg template migrate`

```text
Upgrade templates to the current schema version.

Directories are scanned recursively. The original of a rewritten file is kept as `<file>.bak`; the new file loses its comments. Files already at the current version are not touched.

Usage: wpg template migrate [OPTIONS] <PATHS>...

Arguments:
  <PATHS>...
          Template files or directories

Options:
      --check
          Only report outdated templates (exit status 1 if any needs migrating)

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --no-backup
          Do not keep a `.bak` copy of migrated files

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg bench`

合成フレーム (EtherType 0x88b5)、または `--template` で指定したテンプレートをレート無制限で送出します。ベースラインは `docs/perf.md` を参照。`--json` の項目: backend、detail、iface、frame_size、batch_size、packets、dropped、pps、bps (L2)、l1_bps、elapsed。

```text
Measure transmit performance

Usage: wpg bench [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --backend <BACKEND>
          Backend to benchmark

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

  -i, --iface <IFACE>
          Interface (for real backends)

      --duration <DURATION>
          Duration in seconds

          [default: 5]

      --frame-size <FRAME_SIZE>
          Frame size in bytes (without FCS)

          [default: 64]

      --template <FILE>
          Benchmark on-the-fly generation of this template instead of a fixed frame

      --var <NAME=VALUE>
          Template variable override (`name=value`), repeatable (with --template)

      --json
          Output JSON

      --batch <N>
          Frames per `send_batch` call

      --ring-depth <N>
          TX ring depth in frames (`afpacket`)

      --pin-core <CORE>
          Pin the TX thread to this CPU core (Linux; the first worker)

      --pin-cores <CORES>
          Pin worker i to the i-th core of this list, e.g. `1,2` (Linux)

      --workers <N>
          TX worker threads, each with its own backend instance (afpacket: socket and ring) and share of the stream and rate

          [default: 1]

      --qdisc-bypass
          Bypass the qdisc layer (`afpacket`, `PACKET_QDISC_BYPASS`)

      --no-tx-ring
          Use `sendmmsg` instead of the TPACKET_V3 TX ring (`afpacket`)

      --auto-pin
          Pin the workers to cores on the NIC's NUMA node, core 0 last (Linux; ignored when --pin-cores is given)

      --queue <N>
          First hardware queue (`afxdp`, `dpdk`; worker i uses queue N+i)

      --xdp-mode <MODE>
          AF_XDP bind mode: auto (zero-copy, else copy), copy or zerocopy

          [default: auto]

      --busy-poll
          Busy polling: `afxdp` sockets busy-poll the driver (kernel 5.11+) and `wpg send` paces with `--wait busy-poll` unless --wait says otherwise

      --eal-args <ARGS>
          DPDK EAL arguments (`dpdk`), e.g. "-a 0000:00:04.0 --file-prefix wpg" (split on whitespace; wpg adds `-l <first CPU>` and `--in-memory` unless given)

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg capture`

```text
Receive: counters, the first frames, pcapng output, signature verification

Usage: wpg capture [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -i, --iface <IFACE>
          Interface to receive on (`any` = every interface with `afpacket`); for the `pcapfile` backend the capture file to replay

      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

      --backend <BACKEND>
          Receive backend: afpacket (Linux), pcap (feature `pcap`), pcapfile, null

  -f, --filter <EXPR>
          tcpdump-style filter, e.g. `udp port 5001 and wpg` (default: every frame)

  -c, --count <COUNT>
          Stop after this many matching frames

      --duration <DURATION>
          Stop after this long, e.g. `10s`

      --show <N>
          Print the first N matching frames

          [default: 5]

      --hex
          Also print a hex dump of the shown frames

  -w, --write <FILE>
          Write the matching frames to this pcapng file

      --verify
          Check the signatures stamped by `wpg send --signature` (loss / order / latency)

      --promisc
          Promiscuous mode

      --include-outgoing
          Also count frames this host transmits

      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `wpg config`

`wpg.toml` のツール。[設定リファレンス](config.md)を参照してください。

```text
Configuration file tools (init, show, validate)

Usage: wpg config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init          Write a fully commented example `wpg.toml`
  show          Print the effective configuration (file + environment) as TOML, secrets redacted
  validate      Check the configuration; exit status 1 on errors
  set-password  Prompt for the admin password and store its argon2id hash as `auth.password_hash` (the file is created from the example if missing)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --protocols-dir <DIR>
          Directory of user-defined protocol files (`*.yaml`, repeatable; added to `[protocols] dirs` of `wpg serve`)

          [env: WPG_PROTOCOLS_DIR]

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```
